items.title: Terry Clark — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We call him “the King,” because he’s the boss at doing everything... He’s a very talented man.

ctx.x: The thing about him is he – every experience I’ve had with him, he’s the ultimate gentleman.

He’s the most gentlemanly gentleman you’ll ever meet in your life. He’s a marvelous person. We call him “the King,” because he’s the boss at doing everything, playing trumpet, playing alto, playing trombone, piano, arranging, composing, and movie scores and all. He’s a very talented man.
First time around we talked about Sy McField.
